'X but it's 197x' keeps compounding for techhalla: 'Pirates of the Caribbean but it's 1974' 12.7K views / 444 likes and 'Futurama but it's 1971' 9.6K / 372 likes - one-line title, nostalgic film look, no tool talk.
Franchise-sequel bait: EHuanglu's 'AI is ready to make Ice Age 7' hit 10.2K with a 7-word caption.
Creator-program and tool posts held the floor: azed_ai's AZ8 Creator Program post 7.7K, 2D-to-3D character design 6.5K, Topaz Wonder 4 upscale 5.0K; MayorKingAI's AZ8 post stayed at 4.1K.

Outside the watchlist the meta is MiniMax H3 vs Seedance 2.5 price/quality comparisons (kentdhani 8.2K) and Seedance 2.5 showcases (Nely_Brooks 7.4K); AIWarper's ComfyUI H3 Image carousel tips stayed under 3.5K but were heavily bookmarked.
